name: sentry
description: Connects the site's error tracking to Sentry through Tovu's Sentry provider plugin (observability-sentry). Ships the know-how and a secure key card: the person pastes the project's DSN and an optional environment name; Tovu saves them for every site in the project. No Sentry code here; the provider plugin reports the errors.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Sends your site's errors to Sentry. Ask the assistant to add error tracking.

credentialCards.title: Connect Sentry
credentialCards.label: Sentry
credentialCards.intro: Send this site's errors to Sentry.
usedFor: Reports server errors and slow requests to your Sentry project
credentialCards.keyHint: In Sentry open Project settings → Client Keys (DSN) and copy the DSN.
